correlationLimit: Old group logs omit taskId/window; association needs one request per loop and an unambiguous parent window. Nested/parallel work sums are never wall time or SLO.

traceAudit.limitation: Trace extraction alone proves neither query completeness nor capacity. Legacy logs without G5_TRACE have no new-probe observations; cancelled or missing clocks remain explicit.
